item.title: Daily Court Digest: Major environment orders (January 29, 2026)
item.description: The National Green Tribunal emphasized strict adherence to its orders on Narmada river rejuvenation, mandating quarterly reviews. A joint committee will investigate illegal stone-crushing near Renuka river, while responses are sought for a housing project in Rajarhat lacking environmental clearance.

item.title: Budget 2026: What it signals for water, sanitation, river conservation
item.description: The Union Budget 2026-27 prioritizes water supply, sanitation, and river conservation with a Rs 2,16,654 crore allocation. Key schemes like AMRUT, SBM, and Jal Jeevan Mission aim to enhance infrastructure, water access, and sustainable practices across India.

item.title: Daily Court Digest: Major environment orders (February 2, 2026)
item.description: Chromium levels in blood samples from Kanpur districts exceed limits, prompting health camps and surveys. IIT Kanpur plans comprehensive environmental mapping. Bihar's Gaya STP scheme progresses with IIT Kharagpur's appraisal nearing completion.

item.title: Budget 2026-27 restores big funding for rural water and sanitation after steep cuts, but delivery gaps from last year persist
item.description: The 2026-27 budget significantly boosts funding for rural water and sanitation, reversing last year's cuts. However, implementation delays persist, with nearly Rs 50,000 crore unspent in 2025-26. Despite increased allocations, questions remain about the capacity and pace of execution.

item.title: US courts block Trump’s war on wind energy
item.description: US courts have overturned Trump's halt on five offshore wind projects, allowing them to resume. These projects will generate 6 gigawatts of electricity, enough for 2.5 million homes, countering Trump's push against clean energy.

item.title: AI is coming to Olympic judging: What makes it a game changer?
item.description: The IOC's integration of AI in Olympic judging aims to enhance consistency and transparency, but raises concerns about trust and cultural values. While AI offers technical accuracy, it challenges traditional judging and the essence of sportsmanship, potentially altering the future of Olympic sports.

item.title: India-US trade deal: Centre says agriculture and dairy protected, but lack of text fuels uncertainty
item.description: India claims to protect agriculture and dairy in the US trade deal, but lack of formal text raises concerns. Farmers fear subsidized US imports could harm local markets, while experts warn of political signaling over binding commitments. Uncertainty persists as details remain undisclosed.
